name: Mail Inbox
author: themo
description: Unread mail across all your mailboxes in the Omarchy bar. Plain IMAP, so Gmail (app password) and any other account work through one code path. Click a message to read it in full and reply without leaving the bar.

barWidget.description: One bar icon for all mailboxes: total unread count, with a panel that switches between accounts, opens a message in full and sends replies over SMTP. Scales to many addresses without adding bar clutter.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the mailbox is polled over IMAP.

schema.label: Messages in panel
schema.description: How many unread messages the panel lists.

schema.label: Hide when no unread mail
schema.description: Remove the pill from the bar entirely while the mailbox is read.

schema.label: Reply drafts with Claude
schema.description: Show a Draft button that writes a reply with the local claude CLI, using what you typed as notes. The open message is sent to Anthropic for this. Needs Claude Code installed and logged in.

schema.label: Draft model
schema.description: Which Claude model writes the draft.

schema.label: Draft signature
schema.description: Put under every draft, after the closing line. Write \\n for a line break. Leave empty for none.
